h: Mercy Within Judgment and the Gate of Teshuvah

p: בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ (חֵלֶק ג קפה, ב)
In the holy Zohar on this parshah (III 185b):
'If You, Yah, should keep account of iniquities,
here is Adonai, which is mercy;
should be aroused in judgment, etc.,
מִי יִרְפָּא לָךְ (אֵיכָה ב, יג) וְכוּלֵּי
שֶׁהֲרֵי שֵׁם אֲדֹנָי מוֹרֶה עַל דִּין
"the law of the kingdom is law,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קיח, א וּבִשְׁאָר מְקוֹמוֹת)
as is written (Zohar II 118a and elsewhere);
so how does it say here that it is mercy?
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חָדָשׁ פָּרָשַׁת תָּבוֹא
according to what is written in the Zohar Chadash, parshas Savo,
that the entire section of the rebukes
like a father who raises his rod over his son
And indeed throughout the rebuke of parshas Savo
it is written with the Name Havayah,
which is the Name of mercy;
because in truth the rebuke is mercy,
so that they improve through it.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר כָּאן בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר
And this is why it says here in the holy Zohar mentioned:
that is, only to threaten the person,
in order to benefit him through it
כִּי עַל יְדֵי הַיִּרְאָה יָבֹא לִתְשׁוּבָה
for through fear he will come to teshuvah
מִגְּמָרָא עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה יט, א וְעוֹד)
from the Gemara, Avodah Zarah 19a, and elsewhere).
וְאִם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם גַּם הוּא יִתְּעַר בְּדִינָא
And if, Heaven forbid, it too should be aroused in judgment,
and he not come to teshuvah,
which is reserved for the baal teshuvah;
even though "your breach is great as the sea."
And it appears from the holy Zohar
שֶׁמְּפָרֵשׁ פָּסוּק וַיַּרְאֵנִי אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְגוֹ׳
that it explains the pasuk "And he showed me Yehoshua, etc."
אַף שֶׁאַחַר כָּךְ כְּתִיב (זְכַרְיָה ג, ו-ז)
"And the angel of Hashem warned Yehoshua, etc.:
If you will walk in My ways, etc.,"
which certainly was in his lifetime;
that was at an earlier time.
And this is why it says:
וְכֵן כָּתַב אַחַר כָּךְ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
And so it writes afterward in the holy Zohar:
"that they brought him up to judgment
and one for that one who comes out of Gehinnom,
who always stands to lead astray, etc."
and that is why there is mentioned in connection with him
corresponds to the kelipah of the serpent and lust;
וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ לְהַלָּן (חֵלֶק ג קפו, א)
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar further on (III 186a):
who appears in the image of an ox";
that is, he is the kelipah of Esav.
And this is what it says:
these are the spirits of people,
which are the grass of the field,
which are from the known field,
that this is through the fiftieth gate,
which is reserved for baalei teshuvah, as stated.
